kit_page.name: director_settings_kit
kit_page.summary: Director settings for autosave recovery, cast at login and prompts.

kit_row.help: When an unsaved scene is found: Choose how Director handles an unsaved scene after an interrupted session.
kit_row.keywords: settings recovery autosave restore don't ask
kit_row.label: Unsaved scene

kit_row.help: Every crash backup Director kept, newest first (the newest 2). Choose one, then Restore or Delete.
kit_row.keywords: settings recovery crash backup restore autosave
kit_row.label: Crash backups

kit_row.help: Restore the selected backup: Replace the current scene with the selected crash backup. Asks first, and the backup file is kept.
kit_row.label: Restore backup

kit_row.help: Delete the selected backup: Delete the selected crash backup file. Asks first.
kit_row.label: Delete backup

kit_row.help: Restoring never deletes a backup; old backups age out. Don't restore leaves the newest backup in the Crash backups list.
kit_row.label: About recovery
kit_row.text: Director autosaves while you work. A session that ends without saving leaves a crash backup; the newest 2 are kept. Ask me offers Restore or Discard: Discard deletes only that backup. If "Don't ask me again" is ticked, that backup and later ones are kept without asking (restore them from this list). Closing the prompt keeps it.

kit_row.help: Add me to the cast at login: Adds your avatar to the Director cast after the next login. Set on Capture > Scene, the one home of this setting.
kit_row.label: Add me at login

kit_row.help: Reset 'don't ask again' prompts: Ask about unsaved scenes again and reset only Director notification ignores.
kit_row.keywords: settings recovery autosave restore don't ask
kit_row.label: Reset prompts

kit_row.help: Colour theme for the Director console.
kit_row.keywords: theme colour appearance skin
kit_row.label: Theme

kit_row.help: Flip the chosen theme between light and dark, keeping its colours. Record stays red. Global preference; not saved in scenes.
kit_row.keywords: invert theme light dark flip colour appearance skin
kit_row.label: Invert theme

kit_row.help: How solid the Director's backgrounds are. 100% = solid; lower lets the world show through. Text and controls stay solid.
kit_row.keywords: opacity transparent see-through background solid
kit_row.label: Background opacity

kit_row.help: Show the name tags of whoever the open Director page acts on with a theme-coloured background. Replaces the yellow selected-clone tag text. Local only; not saved in scenes.
kit_row.keywords: name tag nametag highlight selected edited actor clone group colour background invert accent
kit_row.label: Highlight edited name tags

kit_row.help: Keep the cursor hidden over the viewer while the interface is hidden, even when moving or clicking. Restores with the interface or outside the viewer. Global preference; not saved in scenes.
kit_row.keywords: hide cursor mouse pointer interface ui filming capture external recording
kit_row.label: Hide cursor with interface

kit_row.help: Turn your avatar to face an object when you right-click, edit or select it.
kit_row.keywords: turn face avatar right click select edit build object selection rotation
kit_row.label: Turn to face selected objects

kit_row.help: Replace the idle v2 transport ACTION button with a confirmed All Off reset. CUT still cuts live takes. F3 still starts ACTION. Enter never resets features.
kit_row.keywords: action all off reset transport replace disable lighting restore
kit_row.label: Replace ACTION with All Off

kit_row.help: Restore the feature switches, Personal Lighting and Avatar Light Response saved before the last All Off. The backup is kept.
kit_row.keywords: all off reset undo restore backup lighting features
kit_row.label: Restore last reset

kit_row.help: Stops rigged mesh popping between detail levels; higher = steadier, slightly more GPU.
kit_row.keywords: rigged mesh lod hysteresis popping detail avatar steady flicker
kit_row.label: LOD hysteresis

kit_row.help: Engineering switch: faster shadow-pass target transitions. Off = stock behaviour.
kit_row.keywords: engineering shadow direct transitions framebuffer pass switch kill
kit_row.label: Shadow passes

kit_row.help: Engineering switch: buffer-pool cleanup at frame end to avoid mid-frame stalls. Off = stock behaviour.
kit_row.keywords: engineering vbo buffer pool cleanup stall frame end
kit_row.label: VBO pool cleanup

kit_row.help: Under VRAM pressure, unused textures can be freed and the purge is spread over frames instead of one long hitch. Off = old behaviour.
kit_row.keywords: texture purge vram pressure memory hitch spread frames
kit_row.label: Spread texture purges

kit_row.help: Holds scene textures at loaded resolution during takes. VRAM pressure can suspend the pin; hover here for status.
kit_row.keywords: capture pin textures full resolution suspended vram
kit_row.label: Pin scene textures (no degrade during takes)

kit_row.help: Upstream fix: caps geometry work at 5 ms and bounds object creation after teleport. Turn off to compare.
kit_row.keywords: upstream performance ab compare GeomBudgetCap
kit_row.label: Cap geometry budget

kit_row.help: Upstream fix: uploads small mips and glyphs in fewer calls. Turn off to compare.
kit_row.keywords: upstream performance ab compare BatchedRowUploads
kit_row.label: Batch texture rows

kit_row.help: Upstream fix: reuses matrix inverses between shader switches. Turn off to compare.
kit_row.keywords: upstream performance ab compare CachedMatrixInverse
kit_row.label: Cache matrix inverses

kit_row.help: Upstream fix: combines attachment texture visibility scans once per avatar update. Turn off to compare.
kit_row.keywords: upstream performance ab compare CoalescedBodyVisibility
kit_row.label: Coalesce body visibility

kit_row.help: Silence a group chat for this many minutes when Ask is off.
kit_row.keywords: group chat snooze silence duration minutes communication IM
kit_row.label: Snooze minutes

kit_row.help: Choose 15 minutes, 30 minutes or 1 hour each time you snooze a group chat.
kit_row.keywords: group chat snooze ask prompt duration communication IM
kit_row.label: Ask snooze duration
